note: A partition mapping every column back to the base ID keeps one base variable; a literal blank column of a later edition does not disturb it.
fails_if: `_column_partition_plan` counts the 2022 row's literal-blank (`negative`) Kolumnnamn as a delivered column, so the OLD/NEW map no longer covers the complete column set and the partition goes stale

sources.description: Variable 1.5 delivered as OLD (2020, CVID 21), NEW (2021, CVID 22) and with a quoted empty column name (2022, CVID 23).
